node.title: XR graded tangent band charge (ratified Route T third generic column): band-column slope count fits the exact free headroom H_band=s_lo-16n^3, with cascade tier d=h-1 named
node.statement: At each of the six clean-rate candidates, every globally generic-branch received pair has band-column slope count |Gamma_band|<=H_band(C):=s_lo(C)-16n^3, with the cascade tier d=h-1 included in the ratified third generic column. The campaign phrase '13n^3 headroom' is a lower floored description of H_band, not an upper bound. Rounds 7-11 prove all pricing and reduction inputs except the prize-row high-window occupancy leaf xr_band_high_window_exclusion (SL-2): for ceil(h/2)<=d<=h-2, the support-wise first-match selected occupancy must satisfy 25N_d<=17n^2. The low depths already obey this envelope, the cascade has N_{h-1}<=n/2, and exact divisor-block arithmetic gives floor(17n^2/25)SUM_d L(d)+floor(n/2)(n-A+1)<=H_band at every prize row. The projective multiplicity, high-depth injectivity, and averaged-window reduction are proved in xr_band_windowed_projection_reduction; the canonical MC/coset adversary is excluded from this window by xr_mc_depth_quantization. RowC budgets are vacuous. Thus this node is conditional on SL-2 alone.
